businessName: Polaris Hair Studio by Sumeet & Sujeet
whatsappMessage:
Hi Sumeet & Sujeet,

I noticed Polaris Hair Studio has outstanding 4.6★ reviews from 760+ clients on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new salon appointments.

Maine aapke studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, service menu (hair styling, grooming, treatments), aur gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/polaris

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Sumeet ji / Sujeet ji, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine Polaris Hair Studio ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha.
